Thanks for the flag, Grace. I reviewed ResellCo's redlines. Below are legal's recommendations and the rationale — please review and confirm.

1) Narrow definition: Replace their proposed "pass-through" with a defined term: "Marketplace Transaction Fees and Transactional Taxes" meaning (a) taxes imposed on the sale of the product or service to the end-customer and (b) fees charged by the marketplace operator for listing/fulfillment for that order. This prevents interpretation creep into indemnity or licensing fees.

2) Limitation of Liability carve: Add a sentence that Redwood's acceptance of pass-through shall not expand Redwood's liability to or create new indemnity obligations with respect to any third-party marketplace operator or the reseller's upstream vendors. If the reseller requires a separate upstream indemnity, it must be negotiated separately.

3) Evidence & Invoice format: Require ResellCo to provide marketplace invoice reference (marketplace transaction id + original order id) and an authorized reseller invoice with matching amounts. Without matching evidence Redwood reserves the right to withhold pass-through.

4) Holdback / escrow: Legal prefers a 30-day dispute window (standard) with ability to extend to 60 days on a case-by-case basis. Proposal: default 30 days, extendable by written notice. Escrow should be a bookkeeping hold — not a third-party escrow account unless required by procurement.

5) Signer-exception clause: We can accept a limited signer-exception when the marketplace operator invoices ResellCo directly, provided ResellCo confirms in writing that (i) ResellCo is the billed party and (ii) Redwood will not be required to pursue the end-customer for payment. Add a short representation to the Order Form certifying the reseller's billing obligations.

Next steps: I will draft redline language (tracked changes) that reflects the above and preserve standard Redwood indemnity/liability caps. If Ops confirms the required tags/checkbox, we can send consolidated redlines to ResellCo tomorrow morning.
